how_to_apply: Download the application form on the prescribed proforma (Annexure A) from the official notification PDF.
Fill out the required details in the application form completely and accurately.
Attach self-attested copies of educational qualifications, experience certificates, and other relevant documents.
Affix an attested passport size photograph on the application form.

Submit the completed application form by post or in person to reach the office of the undersigned (Pulses Section, Department of Genetics and Plant Breeding, CCS HAU, Hisar-125004) latest by 22-10-2026, 9:30 am.

important_instructions: The appointment is temporary up to 31-3-2027 and maximum duration of engagement of YP-II is three years (1+1+1+1)/duration of the post, whichever is earlier. Ph.D. students have to produce NOC from the Dean PGS at the time of interview. The engagement of YP-II in the project will be full time and will not be allowed to do any other work or to accept or hold another appointment. Selected candidate must report for duty within 15 days of issue of order of appointment. Selected candidate will be required to execute an agreement on a Non-judicial Stamped paper of Rs. 15/- before joining. Selected candidate will not be a regular employee of the University and will not be entitled to any CPF/GPF or other benefits.

content_sections.heading: CCS HAU Young Professional-II (YP-II) Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Young Professional-II (YP-II) position under scheme 5397-C(b) PB-184-ICAR at the Pulses Section, Department of Genetics and Plant Breeding.

content_sections.heading: CCS HAU Young Professional-II (YP-II) Eligibility Criteria

rows.qualification_required: M.Sc. with 60% in Genetics and Plant Breeding/Agronomy or Graduate in Agricultural Sciences. (Candidate with working experience in pulse crops will be given preference).

content_sections.heading: CCS HAU Young Professional-II (YP-II) Age Limit
content_sections.text: Minimum 21 years and maximum 45 years on the last date of submission of application. Relaxation as per university rules.

content_sections.heading: CCS HAU Young Professional-II (YP-II) Salary
content_sections.text: TA/DA will be payable equivalent to the entitlement of Grade-IV employees as mentioned in CCS HAU TA Rules of the University. However, no TA/DA will be payable for appearing in the interview.

content_sections.heading: CCS HAU Young Professional-II (YP-II) Application Fee
content_sections.text: The notification does not mention any application fee.

content_sections.heading: CCS HAU Young Professional-II (YP-II) Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be made through an interview. The interview will be held on 22-10-2026, at 10:00 am in the office of Director of Research, CCS HAU, Hisar. Original Certificates will be required to produce/shown at the time of interview (along with certified true copies or original certificates to be submitted to the University).

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CCS HAU Young Professional-II (YP-II)
content_sections.text: Download the application form on the prescribed proforma (Annexure A) from the official notification PDF. Fill out the required details in the application form completely and accurately. Attach self-attested copies of educational qualifications, experience certificates, and other relevant documents. Affix an attested passport size photograph on the application form. Submit the completed application form by post or in person to reach the office of the undersigned (Pulses Section, Department of Genetics and Plant Breeding, CCS HAU, Hisar-125004) latest by 22-10-2026, 9:30 am. Attend the walk-in interview on 22-10-2026 at 10:00 am at the office of Director of Research, CCS HAU, Hisar along with original certificates.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Prescribed application proforma (Annexure A) Attested passport size photograph Original certificates and certified true copies of educational qualifications Experience certificates (if any) NOC from Dean PGS (for Ph.D. students at the time of interview) Medical certificate of fitness from the CMO of the University (at the time of joining, if selected)

content_sections.heading: CCS HAU Young Professional-II (YP-II) Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The appointment is temporary up to 31-3-2027 and maximum duration of engagement of YP-II is three years (1+1+1+1)/duration of the post, whichever is earlier. Selected candidate can leave or services can be terminated at any time by giving one month notice or one-month emoluments in lieu thereof. Ph.D. students have to produce NOC from the Dean PGS at the time of interview. The engagement of YP-II in the project will be full time and will not be allowed to do any other work or to accept or hold another appointment. Selected candidate must report for duty within 15 days of issue of order of appointment. Selected candidate will be required to execute an agreement on a Non-judicial Stamped paper of Rs. 15/- before joining. Selected candidate will not be a regular employee of the University and will not be entitled to any CPF/GPF or other benefits.

faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment for?
faq.answer: This is a recruitment notification by CCS HAU for 1 post of Young Professional-II (YP-II) under project 5397-C(b) PB-184-ICAR in the Pulses Section, Department of Genetics and Plant Breeding.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Young Professional-II (YP-II) post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The completed application must reach the office of the undersigned latest by 22-10-2026, 9:30 am.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc. with 60% in Genetics and Plant Breeding/Agronomy or a Graduate in Agricultural Sciences.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 21 years and maximum age is 45 years on the last date of submission of application, with relaxations as per university rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must submit their applications on the prescribed proforma (Annexure A) by post or in person to the Pulses Section, Department of Genetics and Plant Breeding, CCS HAU, Hisar, and attend the walk-in interview on 22-10-2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Selection is based on an interview scheduled for 22-10-2026 at 10:00 am at the office of Director of Research, CCS HAU, Hisar.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary for Young Professional-II?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a fixed salary of Rs. 42,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, this is a contractual appointment up to 31-3-2027, likely to be extended, and the maximum duration is up to three years. Selected candidates will not be regular employees of the university.
